about: A demand whose condition has no FACT lands REQUIRED: owed, with no take and no refusal of its batch. Its take runs when the condition is paid and the batch is landed again. Refusal is for a line that is not an act.

cases.name: a batch of one conditioned demand, on a scratch copy
cases.said: OWED     take bound/src/judge/owed-until-its-condition-is-paid · it rests on bound/src/judge/a-condition-nobody-has-paid, which has no FACT: it stands owed until that is paid

red was: a demand with an unpaid condition refused its batch
